doc: float32 directions give float32 lon and lat (arctan2 and arcsin in float32). Includes the poles and the antimeridian, float32 z just below 1 (0.99999994, where arcsin is ill-conditioned but the input is exact) and z beyond 1 (clipped). Measured against the float64 evaluation of the same float32 inputs: 1.2e-7 in lon, 8.9e-8 in lat; tolerance 2e-6 abs + 1e-5 rel (more than 10x).
